decks.name: LeetCode #78 - Subsets
decks.description: Generate all possible subsets (power set) of an array

cards.question: Subsets: Given an integer array nums of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set). The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets. Return the solution in any order.

solutions.name: Backtracking
solutions.explanation: Use recursive backtracking to explore all subset possibilities. At each index, make two recursive choices: include current element or exclude it. Base case when index reaches array length, add current subset copy to result. Include element by appending to subset, recurse, then backtrack by popping. Then recurse without including element. Generates all 2^n subsets. O(n*2^n) time for generating and copying subsets.

solutions.timeDescription: Generate 2^n subsets, each requiring O(n) time to copy to result array
solutions.spaceDescription: Recursion stack depth O(n), subset array O(n), output stores 2^n subsets totaling O(n*2^n) elements
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Given nums=[1,2,3]: Start dfs(0). Include 1: subset=[1], dfs(1). Include 2: subset=[1,2], dfs(2). Include 3: subset=[1,2,3], add to res. Backtrack, exclude 3: subset=[1,2], add to res. Backtrack to dfs(1), exclude 2: subset=[1], dfs(2). Include 3: subset=[1,3], add. Exclude 3: subset=[1], add. Continue pattern for all combinations. Result: [[1,2,3],[1,2],[1,3],[1],[2,3],[2],[3],[]].

solutions.name: Iteration
solutions.explanation: Build subsets iteratively without recursion. Start with empty subset in result. For each number in array, create new subsets by adding number to all existing subsets, then add these new subsets to result. Each iteration doubles number of subsets. After processing all numbers, have complete power set. Clean iterative approach using list comprehension. O(n*2^n) time, O(2^n) space for output.

solutions.name: Bit Manipulation
solutions.explanation: Use binary representation to generate subsets. For n elements, iterate through all numbers from 0 to 2^n-1. Each number's binary representation indicates which elements to include (1) or exclude (0). For each number, check each bit position; if bit is set, include corresponding element in subset. Generates all subsets in lexicographic order based on binary counting. O(n*2^n) time, elegant mathematical approach.

codeLines: subset = [nums[j] for j in range(n) if (i & (1 << j))]
